niche.habitat: Persistent fog banks and anticyclone edges (3-5 km altitude). Also, in the council's sketch (no such creature in this world yet): Brisacoral, both filter the same aerosol layer; SoplilloAlado dominates the upper canopy.
niche.diet: Aerosolized microbes, spores, and organic condensates

body: Broad, porous membrane wings; low-mass gas-filled skeleton; ciliated oral grooves

links: High air density allows low-Reynolds flight
Selects for passive lift over muscular flapping
Porosity adds surface area for particle capture without drag

skill.effect: The creature drifts smoothly on rising air currents, staying aloft with barely any effort. It can remain airborne for a long time without tiring.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to sudden downdrafts in anticyclone edges; forced to land.
observe: Pods align perfectly with wind shear

journal.en: They weave the mist into bread, then sail the sky on the crumbs.

plausibility.summary: Cap wing porosity to 5–15% specialized zones; keep primary membranes tight. Set primary fog-feeding altitude to 0.5–2.5 km within anticyclone domes, with rare ups to ~3 km only over the highest volcanic shields (F18).
fixes: Cap wing porosity to 5–15% specialized zones; keep primary membranes tight. Set primary fog-feeding altitude to 0.5–2.5 km within anticyclone domes, with rare ups to ~3 km only over the highest volcanic shields (F18).

analogues.organism: Albatross and frigatebird dynamic soaring/soaring (passive lift on winds); monarch butterflies and gossamer spiders use large light surfaces in dense boundary layers; baleen whales separate 'filter surface' from 'propulsion surface'.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Ciliated oral grooves for particle capture
links: Gravity cannot precipitate fine aerosols quickly
Cilia sweep particles into digestive tract at low energy cost

skill.effect: Automatically gathers nutrients while moving, grants +5 stamina regen per turn.

chains.weakness: Cilia clog instantly in dry, volcanic ash storms; requires grooming cooldown.
observe: Droplets bead and roll into oral ridges

journal.en: Breathing is eating, and eating is flying.

plausibility.summary: F8–F9 humidity and F12 persistent fog support long-residence aerosols (spores, condensates, microbial hitchhikers) that fine gravity settling under 1.85 g still won't purge quickly from a turbulent fog layer. Low-energy ciliary transport into a groove is a standard suspension-feeding solution when Reynolds number in the groove is low. F19 haze and NIR-shifted productivity imply particulate and condensate organic flux aloft.
fixes: F8–F9 humidity and F12 persistent fog support long-residence aerosols (spores, condensates, microbial hitchhikers) that fine gravity settling under 1.85 g still won't purge quickly from a turbulent fog layer. Low-energy ciliary transport into a groove is a standard suspension-feeding solution when Reynolds number in the groove is low. F19 haze and NIR-shifted productivity imply particulate and condensate organic flux aloft.

analogues.organism: Sponges (choanocyte collars), mussels and oysters (gill cilia), salps (mucous-net filter), housefly and mosquito labellum sweeping.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Internal chambers diffuse atmospheric pressure to equalize load

skill.effect: The creature floats lightly in the air, easily shrugging off strikes. It lands softly without any injury from drops.

chains.weakness: Rapid pressure changes cause decompression sickness; movement speed halved until stabilized.
observe: Body floats unnaturally still when resting
Thin bones visible through translucent membrane
Sigh-like exhalations release warm gas clouds

journal.en: Heavy sky, light bones. They cheat gravity with a lungful of atmosphere.

plausibility.summary: Treat chambers as partial buoyancy and shock cushioning (10–30% effective weight reduction aloft), not full neutral buoyancy. Cap body mass to insect–small-vertebrate scale (gram to low kilogram). Tie 'fall immunity' to low terminal velocity from high drag in dense air plus light pneumatization, not true floating at rest.
fixes: Treat chambers as partial buoyancy and shock cushioning (10–30% effective weight reduction aloft), not full neutral buoyancy. Cap body mass to insect–small-vertebrate scale (gram to low kilogram). Tie 'fall immunity' to low terminal velocity from high drag in dense air plus light pneumatization, not true floating at rest.

analogues.organism: Bird pneumatic skeleton (mass reduction, not lighter-than-air); physostome fish swim bladder with duct (pressure equilibration); spider and larval ballooning (external silk, not body buoyancy).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: 18% O2 at 10 bar fouls iron-based carriers
Copper complexes bind oxygen efficiently under high pO2
Vascular exchange uses blue hemolymph for thermal regulation

skill.effect: The creature strikes rapidly for a short while, moving with fierce speed. It must pause afterward, as using the ability again too soon causes it to overheat.

chains.weakness: Blood is highly visible in murky fog; predators track the blue gleam.
observe: Underbelly glows faint blue during exertion
Rapid pulse visible in neck region

journal.en: Their blood paints the fog blue, a beacon they cannot hide.

plausibility.summary: F21 copper-based O₂ carriers fit contingent high-pO₂ biochemistry: at 10 bar with ~18% O₂, inspired partial pressure is far above Earth's; copper hemocyanin-like proteins are well known for O₂ binding in invertebrates and avoid some iron autoxidation pitfalls at high oxygen, though O₂ toxicity still demands compartmentalization and low-permeability barriers. Visible blue under exertion is consistent with oxygenated hemocyanin optics.
fixes: F21 copper-based O₂ carriers fit contingent high-pO₂ biochemistry: at 10 bar with ~18% O₂, inspired partial pressure is far above Earth's; copper hemocyanin-like proteins are well known for O₂ binding in invertebrates and avoid some iron autoxidation pitfalls at high oxygen, though O₂ toxicity still demands compartmentalization and low-permeability barriers. Visible blue under exertion is consistent with oxygenated hemocyanin optics.

analogues.organism: Horseshoe crab and cephalopod hemocyanin (blue oxygenated blood); tarantula and other arthropod hemocyanin.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

relations.note: Rarely falls prey to ash-plows during sudden updrafts; relies on altitude.
(council kind 'competition') Both harvest ground-level organics; RastreadorCeniza dominates the soil layer.

body_plan.origin: Evolved from gliding insectoid ancestors that colonized the fog layer

temperament: Docile, nomadic, highly social in drifting pods
secrets: Pods secrete a sticky, sugar-rich mucus that crystallizes in dry winds.
Their cilia can taste specific chemical signatures of approaching storms.
moments: At dawn, a thousand azure-silver pods catch the first amber light, dissolving into the fog like breath on glass.
